steps.title: Initialize App Settings
steps.description: Configure system-level package metadata and register package name com.hellokoata.app.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with correct target SDK 34, minimum SDK 21, and namespace settings suitable for AGP 8.3.2.

steps.title: Define Android Manifest Properties
steps.description: Setup AndroidManifest.xml referencing default material styles and specifying launcher activity.

steps.title: Design User Interface Layout
steps.description: Design an elegant, centered user interface showcasing the requested message 'hello ko ata'.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java loading the layout resource cleanly using pure standard Android SDK.

steps.title: Validate Namespace and XML Structure
steps.description: Ensure there are no erroneous namespace definitions and that relative imports are accurate.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Confirm that all Java code aligns strictly with Java 8 specifications avoiding modern lambda/streams structures.

steps.title: Optimize Layout Design
steps.description: Adjust typography, color schemes, and margins of the TextView displaying 'hello ko ata'.

steps.title: Validate Project Directory Tree
steps.description: Review final source configuration tree to assure proper build capabilities.

steps.title: Building Hello Ko Ata
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build target debug APK for distribution.
